Sinner Surgery Update — AO 2027 in Doubt
**Facts — HIGH confidence:**
- Sinner's 2026 season ended Oct 6 due to right knee inflammation. He won Wimbledon 2026. — HIGH (Nov 23 pipeline, Al Jazeera, multiple sources)
- Sinner has stated Australian Open 2027 (Jan 17–31) as his return target. — HIGH (multiple sources from October 2026)
- Australian Open 2027 dates: January 17–31, 2027. — HIGH (official)
**Facts — MEDIUM confidence (single source):**
- Lyon specialist initially recommended against surgery. Multiple medical consultations followed. — MEDIUM (puntodebreak.com + essentiallysports.com, undated)
- Surgery has not been ruled out; non-surgical treatment ran approximately 4 months. — MEDIUM (undated sources: athlonsports.com + tennisuptodate.com)
- If surgery proceeds, AO 2027 participation would be jeopardized. — MEDIUM (inference from treatment timeline)
**Facts — LOW confidence (do not use in articles):**
